answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, capped per identity per epoch, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. A sonnet of per-task receipts records who did what, and the hollow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the falcon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
